My first attempt at a true Boss, might seem familiar to anyone who has heard of the “Bowl of Embers: Savage”.

notes.effect: Balistar is a very punchy and dangerous enemy, but he has a soft heart for real heroes and those who help his people.  His stat block is technically over budget, but it is counterbalanced by Fondness for Heroism, which is more a weakness than a boon.

B0BDgF6EVAawie8FXNSQ.description: Balistar is mighty giant clad in armor and the sole guardian of the Green Peaks. Balistar guards the mountains at the behest of a mighty dragon who promised to help him find his kin. With his incredible throwing arm, he assaults any who trespass with fierce determination.  Yet heroic acts of sacrifice will make him pause, as they remind him of his late brother who gave his life to save Balistar.  All he wants is to be reunited with his people, and he believes the dragon is the only one that can help him.

special.effect: Balistar is immune to weak and slow.
special.name: Unstoppable Force

special.effect: Balistar admires heroic deeds. If he witnesses an enemy risk their life to protect someone innocent, Balistar will hesitate and not take any actions on the following turn.  For the rest of the scene, he cannot make attacks against the heroic character or the person they are defending. This can only occur once each scene.
special.name: Fondness for Heroism

special.effect: If a character in the scene is arrogant, rude or directly insults Balistar or his kin, Balistar will perform a free attack of his choice against the offender as a reaction.
